positive_terms: Description of management's role in governance processes, controls and procedures used to monitor, manage and oversee impacts, risks and opportunities

Description of management's role in governance processes, controls and procedures used to monitor, manage and oversee impacts, risks and opportunities。管理层监督职责。治理机构成员不是员工总数；性别多样性和独立性分母、机构范围及统计时点必须明确。责任、能力和监督分别举证。
